import functools

def is_end(s):
    if not s: return True
    if all(x == 0 for x in s): return True
    n = len(s)
    for i in range(n):
        others_sum = sum(s) - s[i]
        if s[i] > others_sum:
            return True
    return False

@functools.lru_cache(None)
def solve(s):
    s = tuple(sorted(s))
    if is_end(s):
        return len(s)
    
    # A wants to maximize
    best_for_a = -1
    
    # All possible pairs (i, j)
    n = len(s)
    # A chooses indices i, j
    # To avoid duplicate pairs, we use indices
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            x, y = s[i], s[j]
            remaining = list(s)
            remaining.pop(j) # pop larger index first
            remaining.pop(i)
            
            # B wants to minimize
            # B chooses x+y or |x-y|
            res1 = x + y
            res2 = abs(x - y)
            
            # State after B's choice
            # B chooses which result to minimize the outcome
            s1 = tuple(sorted(remaining + [res1]))
            s2 = tuple(sorted(remaining + [res2]))
            
            # We need to evaluate the outcomes of s1 and s2
            # But wait, s1 or s2 might be the end state!
            # The game ends at the end of the round.
            
            val1 = solve(s1)
            val2 = solve(s2)
            
            b_choice = min(val1, val2)
            if b_choice > best_for_a:
                best_for_a = b_choice
                
    return best_for_a

for N in range(2, 8):
    initial_state = tuple([1] * N)
    print(f"N={N}, cookies={solve(initial_state)}")

    n = len(s)
    s_sum = sum(s)
    for i in range(n):

            return True
    return False

    if is_end(s):
        return len(s)
    
    best_for_a = -1

        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            x, y = s[i], s[j]
            remaining = list(s)
            remaining.pop(j)
            remaining.pop(i)
            
            # B chooses x+y or |x-y|
            s1 = tuple(sorted(remaining + [x + y]))
            s2 = tuple(sorted(remaining + [abs(x - y)]))
            
            # Important: If s1 or s2 is an end state, the game ends

            val2 = solve(s2)
            
            b_choice = min(val1, val2)
            if b_choice > best_for_a:

    return best_for_a
